scope: Illustrative 2D compressible hydrodynamics with KI-type radiative heating/cooling and deliberately enhanced, temperature-dependent conduction. Not an original-paper reproduction or a demonstration of sustained turbulence.

conductivity.reason: Broaden the cold and intermediate interfaces for a modest resolved grid; this is an explicit illustrative transport model, not the Parker conductivity.

equation_of_state: gamma=5/3; m=1.37 m_H; n=rho/m; P=n k_B T
initial_conditions: Zero velocity; uniform pressure at the unstable equilibrium for mean n; seeded low-wavenumber density perturbations with the stated RMS; temperature adjusts to keep pressure uniform.

video.color_scale: fixed log10 density; no per-frame autoscaling
